submission_confirmation_gate.record_command: python scripts/growth/record_ai_visibility_source_host_execution.py --feed-key mcp_paid_api_discovery --run-group YYYY-MM-DD-after-directory-submission --surface aitoolnet --source-url https://www.aitoolnet.com/finish --evidence-mode submission-confirmation --submitted-payload-summary "Submitted SynapseNetwork MCP Server with Remote MCP endpoint, GitHub, npm package, discover_services, invoke_and_pay, and get_receipt." --screenshot-url docs/archive/evidence/growth/ai-visibility/YYYY-MM-DD-aitoolnet-submission.png --design-handoff-frame "Directory Source-Host Submission Pack" --target-platform chatgpt --target-platform claude --target-query "Synapse vs paid MCP alternatives" --output docs/archive/evidence/growth/ai-visibility/YYYY-MM-DD-aitoolnet-submission-confirmation.json
